title: The ArazzoMetadata JSON schema
description: ArazzoMetadata is a specification for linking the source descriptions of an Arazzo document to the APIs known by Microcks. By convention, such a file is named <name>.arazzo-metadata.yaml: Microcks detects it by its kind, not by its extension.

metadata.title: The metadata of ArazzoMetadata
metadata.description: Holds reference information about the Arazzo document these metadata relate to.

name.title: The name of the Arazzo document these metadata relate to.
name.description: The info.title of the Arazzo document.

version.title: The version of the Arazzo document these metadata relate to.
version.description: The info.version of the Arazzo document.

sources.title: The source descriptions of the Arazzo document
sources.description: The API each source description of the Arazzo document is linked to, by source description name.

sourceItem.title: One source description link
sourceItem.description: The API a source description is linked to.

name.title: The name of the API
name.description: The name of the API in Microcks.

version.title: The version of the API
version.description: The version of the API in Microcks.
